purpose: Expand the CR069a 8-row T2 contact table to 20-30 NV-diamond rows from a deeper published-literature pass. prediction: T2_observed >= T2_grav for any NV-diamond quantum system at its operating omega_drive

interpretation.above_floor_with_margin: consistent with floor; environmental noise still dominates
interpretation.at_floor_within_uncertainty: would constitute strong validation; not yet expected for current measurements
interpretation.below_floor: would falsify CR064a v1.1; expected to surface for some room-temperature Hahn-echo natural-abundance rows where T2_observed ~ 1-5 us approaches or crosses T2_grav ~ 3.4 us at NV resonant

verification_discipline: Every populated row carries citation_tag and verify_status. Initial population is PROVISIONAL_AUTHOR_BEST_EFFORT. Partner-lab confirmation of each citation lifts the row to VERIFIED. Aggregate verdict scales with verified fraction. Identical discipline as CR069a.
